```{r dash-failure-analysis, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)

# ============================================================
# CURRENT RUN
# ============================================================

test_meta <- raw_data %>%
  group_by(run_id) %>%
  summarise(
    sequence_num = first(sequence_num),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

current_run_id <- test_meta %>%
  filter(sequence_num == max(sequence_num)) %>%
  pull(run_id)

# ============================================================
# FAILURE DRIVERS
# ============================================================

failure_items <- c()

# --- Throughput failures ---

if (exists("failed_tp_apps") &&
    nrow(failed_tp_apps) > 0) {

  tp_details <- paste0(
    "<ul>",
    paste(
      sprintf(
        "<li><span class='executive-subtext'>%s - %.2f TPS (Target: %.2f TPS)</span></li>",
        failed_tp_apps$app_name,
        failed_tp_apps$throughput,
        failed_tp_apps$target
      ),
      collapse = ""
    ),
    "</ul>"
  )

  failure_items <- c(
    failure_items,
    paste0(
      sprintf(
        "%s of %s Applications failed Throughput SLA",
        tp_app_total - tp_app_passed,
        tp_app_total
      ),
      tp_details
    )
  )
}

# --- RT failures ---

if (exists("rt_failed_details") &&
    nrow(rt_failed_details) > 0) {

  rt_details <- paste0(
    "<ul>",
    paste(
      sprintf(
        "<li><span class='executive-subtext'>%s - %s ms (SLA: %s ms)</span></li>",
        rt_failed_details$thread_group,
        format(round(rt_failed_details$actual_rt), big.mark = ","),
        format(round(rt_failed_details$threshold), big.mark = ",")
      ),
      collapse = ""
    ),
    "</ul>"
  )

  failure_items <- c(
    failure_items,
    paste0(
      sprintf(
        "%s of %s User Scenarios failed Response Time SLA",
        scenario_failed,
        scenario_total
      ),
      rt_details
    )
  )
}

failure_section <- ""

if (length(failure_items) > 0) {

  failure_section <- paste0(
    "<div class='failure-drivers'>",
    "<ul>",
    paste0("<li>", failure_items, "</li>", collapse = ""),
    "</ul>",
    "</div>"
  )
}

failure_card <- paste0(
'
<div style="
    flex:1;
    background:#f8f9fa;
    border:1px solid #dee2e6;
    border-radius:4px;
    padding:14px;
">
  <h3 class="section-header">
    Primary Failure Drivers
  </h3>
',
failure_section,
'
</div>
'
)

# ============================================================
# TOP BREACHES
# ============================================================

top_breach_section <- ""

if (!is.null(rt_summary) &&
    rt_summary$failed_count > 0) {

  top_breach_section <- paste0(
    "<ul>",
    paste(
      sprintf(
        "<li>%s<br/><span class='executive-subtext'>Actual: %sms | SLA: %sms | Breach: %s%%</span></li>",
        rt_summary$top_breaches$label,
        rt_summary$top_breaches$actual_rt,
        rt_summary$top_breaches$threshold,
        rt_summary$top_breaches$breach_pct
      ),
      collapse = ""
    ),
    "</ul>"
  )
}

breach_card <- paste0(
'
<div style="
    flex:1;
    background:#f8f9fa;
    border:1px solid #dee2e6;
    border-radius:4px;
    padding:14px;
">

  <h3 class="section-header">
    Top Response Time Breaches
  </h3>
',
top_breach_section,
'
</div>
'
)

# ============================================================
# ERROR CARD
# ============================================================

# Re-use your existing error_summary / error_rows logic

# (Paste your existing error_card block here)

# ============================================================
# RENDER
# ============================================================

html_output <- paste0(
'
<div class="sub-executive-summary">
    <div style="
        display:flex;
        align-items:center;
        gap:8px;
    ">
        <h3 class="section-header">
        Failure Analysis
        </h3>
        <i style="
        color:#6c757d;
        cursor:help;
        font-size:14px;
        margin-top:-2px;"
      class="fa fa-info-circle breach-tooltip"
      title="

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATOR (KPI) SUMMARY

Max Users
Peak concurrent virtual users executed during the test.

Apps Passed TPS SLA
Number of applications that met their throughput (TPS) SLA target.

Scenarios Passed P95 Response Time SLA
Number of scenarios that met the configured response time SLA.

Scenarios Passed Error SLA
Number of scenarios that met the configured error rate SLA.

--------------------------------------------------

FAILURE ANALYSIS

Primary Failure Drivers
Summary of the SLA breaches that contributed to the overall test failure.

Top Response Time Breaches
Scenarios or transactions with the largest response time SLA violations.

Top Error Contributors
Transactions that generated the highest number of errors during execution.

--------------------------------------------------

HEALTH SUMMARY

Application Health Summary
Application-level view of performance, showing overall SLA status and key metrics for each application.

Scenario Health Summary
Scenario-level view of performance, showing SLA compliance and key metrics for each business scenario.

Status
Overall PASS when all applicable SLAs are satisfied.
Overall FAIL when one or more SLAs are breached.

Avg. Throughput
Average successful transactions per second (TPS) achieved during the test.

P95 Response Time
95%% of completed transactions finished within this response time.

Error Rate
Percentage of failed transactions compared to total transactions executed.

--------------------------------------------------

CURRENT VS BASELINE COMPARISON

Current
Metrics from the latest test execution.

Baseline
Metrics from the reference test execution used for comparison.

Delta
Percentage change between the current and baseline executions.

">
    </i>
    </div>

  <div style="
      display:flex;
      gap:14px;
      align-items:stretch;
  ">
',
failure_card,
breach_card,
'
  </div>

  <div style="
      margin-top:14px;
  ">
',
error_card,
'
  </div>

</div>
'
)

HTML(html_output)

```
